description.narrative:
Banteay Srei (BS) is a Cambodian women rights organization with over 25 years of experience advancing gender equality, addressing GBV, and promoting women leadership. Guided by its five-year strategic plan, the organization prioritizes economic empowerment, climate resilience, and inclusive governance to create sustainable change for women and girls in vulnerable situations. Its interventionscombine service delivery with systemic advocacy, ensuring survivors of GBV access essential services while also addressing root causes of inequality.
BS is currently implementing the Inclusive Participation for Women Peace Leadership Project, focusing on GBV prevention, survivor support, and leadership promotion, particularly in climate-affected these target areas. Activities include capacity building for women and youth on GBV laws, gender equality, peace and security, and environmental challenges. BS also operates the Safe House which provides counseling, legal support, and economic assistance to approximately 100 survivors annually. In 2023, GBV cases decreased to 125 from 168 the year before, reflecting strengthened prevention and support efforts. The organization further supports the Gender Peace Network (GPN), a community-based mechanism that empowers citizens to address GBV and engage with subnational authorities. In 2024, the GPN supported 124 GBV cases, reinforcing community resilience and accountability.
In this project on Tackling GBV in Conservation in Cambodia, Banteay Srei is responsible for delivering essential training to communities in Stung Treng and Ratanakiri on Gender-based violence and transformative masculinity, supporting the establishment of peer support groups for women and men in pilot communities, mapping and strengthening existing referral pathways, and building survivor-centered support capacity of community focal points.

participating-org.narrative:
BS has been registered with MoI on 17 April 2000, No. 009/2000 as NGO. BS is a Cambodian women’s NGO that empowers vulnerable womento improve their political, economic and psycho-social situation through implementation of community development projects,advocacy work and encouraging men’s participation in addressing issues affecting women. BS is a values-driven organisation, using the following key approaches in its activity design and implementation: 1). A participatory and rights-based approach to building relationshipswith target communities, 2). Working with both men and women to build capacity, confidence and solidarity, 3). Empowering communities and promoting women leaders, 4). Strengthening village development structures; and 5). Co-operation and co-ordination with local authorities and networking with relevant organisations and agencies.
Vision: A just Cambodian society in which women realise their full potential, are living with equality and dignity, and have their rights fully respected.
Mission: BS is a Cambodian women’s non-governmental organisation that empowers women and their families to improve their political, economic and psycho-social situation through mobilising communities for sustainable development, advocacy work for genderjustice and engaging men on gender equality.
Goal: Vulnerable women in BS target areas are empowered to exercise their political, economic and psycho-social rights to enjoy equitable and sustainable development within the family, community and society.
